author: Aldebaran88
quote: It is obvious to me that industry "critics" involve monetary incentive to glaze products. There is nothing positive to say about this game except for maybe good graphics but even that comes at the expense of a pitiful framerate. Sick of being treated with disrespect by companies with woke agendas. These are niche radicals that think they can change culture by taking over movies, Netflix and Star Wars etc. Do they ever learn they do not reflect the majority?
